summary: Pydantic relational AST node types. Eight Substrait-aligned nodes (ReadRelNode, ProjectRelNode, FilterRelNode, SortRelNode, FetchRelNode, JoinRelNode, AggregateRelNode, SetRelNode) live under substrait/; Mountainash-specific nodes (SourceRelNode, RefRelNode, ResourceReadRelNode, ConformRelNode, ExtensionRelNode for util operations) live under extensions_mountainash/. All derive from RelationNode and carry metadata and children, with no execution logic.
key_classes: RelationNode — abstract pydantic base for all plan nodes
ProjectRelNode / FilterRelNode / SortRelNode / FetchRelNode — core single-input nodes
ExtensionRelNode — non-Substrait operations keyed by RKEY_MOUNTAINASH_REL
SourceRelNode / RefRelNode / ResourceReadRelNode — leaf nodes for in-memory sources, DAG references, DataResource reads
extension_points: Subclass RelationNode and register a visit handler via RelationVisitRegistry
ExtensionRelNode operation keys validated by model_validator against the operation registry
lifecycle_notes: d7af5f051 relation sampling and positional execution deferred (#404)
documentation_hooks: Relational AST reference: node catalogue and Substrait mapping
risks: Nodes must stay free of logic beyond accept/children; children enumeration must stay exhaustive for new nodes
Extension node options are loosely typed dicts validated per operation
